title: 2154. Keep Multiplying Found Values by Two

examples.explanation: - 3 is found in nums. 3 is multiplied by 2 to obtain 6. - 6 is found in nums. 6 is multiplied by 2 to obtain 12. - 12 is found in nums. 12 is multiplied by 2 to obtain 24. - 24 is not found in nums. Thus, 24 is returned.
- 4 is not found in nums. Thus, 4 is returned.
